contract.acceptance_criteria: Correct quantified mathematical arguments, accurate source attribution, explicit distinction of paper proof, checked roots and diagnostic computation, no unresolved material issue, twelve isolated role contexts across ten synchronous substantive rounds and final Chief/Alpha/Beta same-byte acceptance.
assumptions: Finite distinct uniform families; three distinct petals and empty core included
Reflexive intersection interface; equivalent to ordinary intersectingness for positive rank
Existing cached dependency objects from pinned source revisions
contract.audience: Researchers in extremal combinatorics and proof assistants
contract.budget: Ten complete rounds, then final audits; additional rounds if needed and runtime allows. Reviewers use concise substantive checks; no optional service provisioning.
contract.citation_style: Numbered primary-source references with immutable versions and theorem locators
constraints: No I27/profile exclusion or all-rank conjecture claim
No public hosting or journal submission
deliverables: Separate machine evidence and review bundle
contract.exclusion: Unperformed search conclusions, unaudited whole-module promotion, unsupported novelty or independence assertions
contract.field: Extremal set theory and formal verification
contract.inclusion: Pinned A1K and OpenAI mathematical snapshots, directly accessed primary literature, actual local proof and computation artifacts
methods: Lean elaboration and axiom print receipts
contract.question: Which universe-independent support and near-extremal completion claims follow from the pinned A1K development, new elementary arguments, and locally checked Lean roots, with all remaining exclusion and formalization obligations explicit?
contract.topic: Finite support reduction and near-extremal completion in sunflower-free families

limitations: Actual separate collaboration contexts; same control environment and unknown provider/model metadata; no organizational independence
Local unsigned hashes and declared tool provenance only; no independent human certification
Bounded source and text comparison; no exhaustive originality claim
